{{Top}}
'''Coolant pumps''' were used on [[Starship/Legends|starships]], like the [[Baudo-class star yacht]], to help move coolant throughout the ship and tended to break down quickly, flooding the ventilation system with harmful fumes. This once happened on the ''[[Pulsar Skate]]'' and injured the pilot, [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]], around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].
